name: Employee Management
short: One record per person: details, documents, bank, salary and history.
headline: Every staff record in one place, with your own fields
intro: Keep personal, job, bank and statutory details for every employee, add the fields your organisation needs, and let staff register themselves for HR to approve.
problem: Staff details spread across Excel sheets, files and WhatsApp messages.
Every organisation needs different fields, but most software forces a fixed form.
New joiners wait days for HR to type in their details and documents.
solution: PayroleHR keeps one record per employee with departments, designations, bank details, PAN, UAN and ESI numbers, plus custom fields you define. Staff can apply from the registration page with mobile OTP; HR reviews and approves before they get portal access.

capabilities.title: Custom fields
capabilities.text: Add text, number, date or list fields that appear on the form and in imports.

capabilities.title: Self-registration
capabilities.text: Staff find your organisation, verify their mobile and upload documents for HR review.

capabilities.title: Bulk import
capabilities.text: Import staff from Excel with row-by-row checks before anything is saved.

capabilities.title: Departments & designations
capabilities.text: Defined by you, used across attendance, payroll and reports.

capabilities.title: Onboarding & offboarding
capabilities.text: Hire from recruitment, track joining tasks, and complete exit clearance.

capabilities.title: Archive, never lose
capabilities.text: Former staff are archived with their history kept for reports.

steps: Set up departments, designations and any custom fields.
Import existing staff or share the registration page.
Approve new joiners; they get portal sign-in automatically.

faqs.q: Can we add our own fields?
faqs.a: Yes. Each organisation defines its own extra fields, and they are validated the same way on the form and in imports.

faqs.q: Can staff fill in their own details?
faqs.a: Yes. Staff register with a one-time SMS code; their application stays pending until HR approves it.
Offboarding clearance sets the leaving date and blocks portal access. Their records stay for reports.

name: Attendance Management
short: Daily attendance with check-in/out times, late and half-day rules.
headline: Attendance that follows your shifts and rules
intro: Mark attendance by face scan, the staff portal or HR entry. Every method uses the same late, early-leaving and half-day rules, so the numbers always match.
problem: Paper registers and manual totals at month end.
Late and half-day rules applied differently by different people.
Attendance and payroll figures that never quite agree.
solution: Check-in and check-out times are stored for every day. One rule set decides Present, Late, Half day or Left early based on the employee's shift and grace time, and the monthly totals flow straight into payroll.

capabilities.title: Several ways to punch
capabilities.text: Face kiosk, staff portal button or face check-in, and HR corrections.

capabilities.title: Shift-aware rules
capabilities.text: Grace minutes, half-day thresholds and weekly offs from the employee's shift.

capabilities.title: Monthly sheet
capabilities.text: See the whole month per employee and correct days with a reason.

capabilities.title: Holidays
capabilities.text: Organisation holiday calendar, with import.

capabilities.title: Overtime requests
capabilities.text: Approved overtime hours become a payroll input.

capabilities.title: Attendance reports
capabilities.text: Daily, monthly, late-comers, absentees and more, exportable to Excel.

steps: Set your shifts and grace time.
Staff punch in and out by face or portal.
Review the month and send it to payroll.

faqs.a: Yes. Paid days, leave and overtime are worked out from attendance when you calculate payroll.

faqs.a: Yes, HR can edit check-in/out times; the same rules re-apply and the change is logged.
